issue.title: Mac CaptureAliasTipPanelTests: three tip-anchoring tests time out on every macOS CI run since aafed83
issue.description:
Proposed by the bob-cli-ji.7.1 phases (bob-cli-ji.7.1.2 note #1, bob-cli-ji.7.1.3 note #1,
bob-cli-ji.7.1.4 notes #1-#2, bob-cli-ji.7.1.5 note #2) and triaged by the bob-cli-ji.7.1
land agent. Not caused by that epic: the same tests fail on base commits that predate it.

## What fails

Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureAliasTipPanelTests.swift`.
Three tests fail with `waitUntil` "Condition not met before timeout" (~8 s each) on every
exact-SHA macOS CI run since the test-anchoring commit `aafed83`
("fix(capture): anchor alias tip fixtures and tests"):

- `testFilteringKeepsTheShownTipAnchoredToTheSigil`
- `testOptionTypedHashOpensTheHashTip`
- `testTypingQueryBeforeTheRouteListOpensKeepsTheTip`

Runs that show them failing: 42826766066 (aafed83), 42838952067 (6b6052c),
42855812749 (7cb516f), 42858829201, 42883209970, 42888193431, 42901006029,
42906549245 (master 62a7b70, which ran 4695 tests with 7 failures, all in this suite).

Two more tests in the same suite fail intermittently in those runs:
`testEditBeforeTheReplyDropsTheTip` (nil vs Optional(1) at line 299; fails on 6b6052c and
62a7b70, passes on aafed83) and `testChangedSeparatorReplyDoesNotDisableTheNextTipRequest`
(failed once on 42901006029). They may share the root cause; confirm while fixing.

## Impact

The bob-mac-capture Test step is red on master, so Bundle, Launch smoke, and
Install/reinstall are skipped on every run. That blocks the green exact-SHA gate that
every Mac change relies on.

## Fix

Find why the tip never appears in these three hosted panel tests on CI (fixture
anchoring after aafed83, the fake-bob tip reply, or the panel wait condition). Fix the
product if the test reflects the intended alias-tip contract, otherwise fix the test.
Do not delete or weaken the assertions. Verify with `Scripts/macos-ci-check` on the
exact SHA.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: All three fail identically, with the same waitUntil timeouts, on every exact-SHA macOS run from aafed83 through master 62a7b70 (at least eight runs on different SHAs). Most of those SHAs touch nothing in alias-tip code, and none of these runs passed them.

issue.creation_reason: Three CaptureAliasTipPanelTests fail on every bob-mac-capture macOS CI run since aafed83. That keeps master's Test step red and skips the bundle and install gates for every Mac change. Five bob-cli-ji.7.1 phases recorded it as a pre-existing failure.
